text:
maria: Heads up — noticed canary with the new resume-heartbeat header is causing a reconnect/jitter spike and duplicate billing marks for some tenants. Console shows route A counts doubled for a tiny subset.

ajay: which canary? run id?

maria: canary-2026-03-resume (rolled ~10:12 UTC). saw spike around 10:18. sample trace: reqs from tenant `acme-inc` kept reconnecting every ~1s for ~20s.

ajay: logs?

maria: pasted a short tail from the proxy logs:

```
[10:18:03] proxy: incoming stream resume id=abcd1234 tenant=acme-inc route=A
[10:18:04] proxy: resume accepted, sticky-route set=host-7
[10:18:05] proxy: client reconnect (no resume header) -> new session id=efgh5678
[10:18:05] billing: request counted for tenant=acme-inc token_cost=4
[10:18:06] proxy: resume attempt id=abcd1234 (duplicate) -> resume accepted
[10:18:06] billing: counted again for tenant=acme-inc token_cost=4
[10:18:07] proxy: client jitter reconnect (tcp reset) -> new session id=ijkl9012
```

maria: so we got duplicate token charges when resume accepted twice during jitter. console groups these under route=A so it looked like a burst, but traces show multiple session ids.

taylor: hmm looks like resume-idempotency isn't sufficient across immediate rebinds. maybe our resume handler currently re-credits on every resume accept instead of deduping by resume-id + short TTL.

lina: also seeing console telemetry sampling weirdness — some of these reconnects are sampled out so we only see partial traces which makes debugging hard. console-dev do we have a per-route sampling that might drop resume traces?

console-dev: yeah we have a sampling filter for high-throughput routes to keep DB costs down. resume events were not tagged as "important" so ~60% dropped. we can change the sampling rule but want to avoid a big egress bump. suggestion: tag resume_accept and session_id changes as high-prio for next 48h.

ajay: quick mitigation: reject resume attempts if we see the same resume-id within X ms for same tenant+route, return `409 duplicate-resume` and let client backoff. will that break legitimate resume semantics?

lina: clients expect resume to be idempotent and accepted if recoverable. returning 409 might cause more reconnect churn on older clients. we should try server-side dedupe first (ignore duplicate accept counting).

maria: agreed. easiest short-term: make billing counting keyed by resume-id + token-window so duplicate accepts within 30s don't double-bill.

ajay: PR incoming. quick config I sketched:

```
service.resume: {
  dedupe_window_ms: 30000,
  duplicate_response: "ignore-billing",
  sticky_route_scope: "session-only"
}
```

maria: also UX got confusing — console shows route A doubled and the canary dashboard flagged a regression. should we mark this canary as failed until dedupe patch lands?

console-dev: yes, canary should be rolled back or paused. we can also add an annotation on the canary that resume-heartbeat is under investigation so owners don't escalate.

deploy-bot: deploy event: rollback canary-2026-03-resume -> queued by @maria at 10:39 UTC :hammer_and_wrench:

sre-oncall: flagging an alert for billing-duplication for affected tenants. paging sent to oncall.

taylor: long-term we should ensure:
- resume-idempotency enforced across proxy/gateway cluster (shared KV)
- console sampling for resume/session events up for 7 days when a rollout touches resume codepath
- route-level cost attribution to include session lineage (session ids + resume ids)

lina: +1. also propose small UX change: when console shows a sudden route burst, include a one-click "show session lineage" that loads the last N session ids and resume ids for that tenant. saves a lot of back-and-forth.

console-dev: we can add a toggle. will prototype a compact timeline in the canary details page.

maria: action items:
- ajay to open quick PR to dedupe billing on resume-id (30s) — aim < 1h
- deploy-bot: rollback canary now (maria triggered)
- console-dev: tag resume_accept as high-prio for sampling and add canary annotation
- taylor/lina: follow-up RFC for cross-cluster resume id store + session lineage UI

ajay: PR: https://git.redwood/infraproj/patches/1234 (wip)

maria: thanks team. please ping me in #oncall if any tenant sees persistent double-charges. :pray:
